newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December S&P 500s end lower in late sell-off.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December S&P 500s end lower in late sell-off.

text.p: Dec 10 - U.S. Dec S&P 500s ended down after a late sell-off in light trade. Traders said a few Wall Street firms turned sellers in the last hour of trade and light pit action exacerbated weakness. One trader estimated 13,000 contracts rolled from Dec to March as March nears lead contract status.
